Several days (depends on the server killing 2000 Yielothax)

In the southwest of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, a {creature:Raging Mage} opened a portal to another dimension at the top of a tower. As long as he is alive, you can cross the portal and hunt {creature:Yielothax} (rare loot) and maybe tame a {wiki:Uniwheel (Mount)|Uniwheel}. When the whole world kills 2000 Yielothax, the mage weakens and can be killed, leaving his unique loot.
A mage in Zao has created a portal to another dimension, which can only stay open while he is alive.
Mission 2 of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed (so you can access the tower).
To fight the Raging Mage: you must have killed at least **250** {creature:Yielothax}.
{spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) to go down and back up the mountain between Farmine and the Zao Steppe.
Potions and equipment to hunt Yielothax and Death Blobs.
In the {wiki:Yielothax Dimension|other dimension}, after crossing the portal at the top of the tower.
Only while the {creature:Raging Mage} is in the tower (world change active). You need Premium and Mission 2 of the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
The portal opens at a random time after the {wiki:Server Save}. Ask a {wiki:Guide NPCs|guide NPC} about {key:mage tower} before you travel.

On the Zao Steppe you may find {creature:Sandcrawler|Sandcrawlers}, {creature:Insect Swarm|Insect Swarms}, {creature:Gnarlhound|Gnarlhounds}, {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds} and possibly orcs along the way.
1. Check whether the mage is active
Talk to a {wiki:Guide NPCs|guide NPC} in any city and ask about {key:mage tower}. If the **Raging Mage** is in the tower, you can go ahead. You can also check at the tower itself.

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}. In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the lift takes you to the surface of the mountain. Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe}.
Exit of the Farmine pass onto the Zao Steppe
Travel to the {wiki:Zao Steppe} and go to the tower ramp, in the south-west. From the exit of the Farmine passage, the tower is to the **east**.
Go up the ramp to the top floor. On every floor except the last there are {creature:Death Blob|Death Blobs}. At the top are the mage and the portals.
At the top is the {creature:Energized Raging Mage}. You can kill him, but he drops no loot and **resurrects immediately** as long as his power has not been weakened. You can ignore him.

Go through the portal to the {wiki:Yielothax Dimension|other dimension}. There you find {creature:Yielothax}, strong and strange creatures with rare loot, and you may come across a {wiki:Uniwheel (Mount)|Uniwheel} to tame.

Kill **at least 250** {creature:Yielothax}: that is the minimum before you can fight the Raging Mage. At the same time, every Yielothax killed weakens the mage: when the **whole world** has killed **2000**, the mage becomes vulnerable.
If you try to enter the tower while the Raging Mage is active without the 250 kills, you get the message *"You have not proven worthy in the dimensional struggle against the yielothax."*

After the world's 2000 kills, kill the {creature:Energized Raging Mage}. He shouts *"GNAAAAAHRRRG!! WHAT? WHAT DID YOU DO TO ME!! [...]"* and resurrects **one last time** as a weaker {creature:Raging Mage}.
Kill the {creature:Raging Mage}. When he dies he says *"I WILL RETURN!! [...]"*. Pick up his unique loot.
After the mage's death, the portal becomes unstable and **closes in 5 minutes**, until the next Server Save. Leave the other dimension in time.
Leave the tower and go back to Farmine

Leave the other dimension before the portal closes (the wiki does not describe the return portal in detail), go down the tower ramp and head back to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}. Climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and go **west** to the lift, which takes you back to Farmine. There, talk to {npc:Thorgrin} at the Steamship: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.
If you hit the Raging Mage, your 250 Yielothax kills reset to zero and you have to get them again for the next time. If you do not hit him, you keep the kills and still have access when he returns.
Before update 9.2, killing 300 Yielothax (instead of 2000) was enough for the mage to appear.
